small_guidance:
- Add autotune configs with larger BLOCK_SP (256, 512) and smaller BLOCK_OC (32) since OC=64 and OH*OW=64516 — the spatial dim has far more parallelism. Also try BLOCK_OC=64, BLOCK_SP=128 with num_warps=4 to reduce register pressure.
- Switch the input layout to NHWC (channels-last) inside the kernel so the IC reduction is contiguous; currently `x_off` strides by IH*IW across IC which hurts coalescing on the K-dim of tl.dot.
- Precompute `oh*IW + ow` once outside the kh/kw static loops and just add `kh*IW + kw` per iteration to cut redundant index math in the unrolled loop.
large_guidance:
- Rewrite as an explicit im2col GEMM: one program per (N, OC-tile, OutSpatial-tile) computing `C[OC, SP] = W[OC, IC*KH*KW] @ X_unfolded[IC*KH*KW, SP]` with a proper K-loop tiled by BLOCK_K=32 or 64 over IC*KH*KW. With IC=8, KH=KW=3, K=72 — pad to 96 and do 3 iterations of BLOCK_K=32, enabling tl.dot to operate on a packed contiguous K dimension instead of the current double-static-loop with K=IC=8 per dot (which underutilizes tensor cores).
- Use NHWC input layout (permute once in forward) so loads along the K axis (IC fastest) are contiguous; this lets the implicit im2col gather coalesce 8-channel chunks per spatial position.
- Consider a persistent-grid kernel that iterates over multiple (N, OC, SP) tiles per program to amortize the weight-tile load across batches, since the same W is reused across all N=128 images.
